instruction.text: Alan is thinking about what he wants to be when he grows up. Select the thought bubble to find out more.
A job is defined by the tasks you must do while working. Listen to why Alan would enjoy the different jobs and match them to the images.

a.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+2st'>I love cooking and baking for others. The joy some people show when they eat something delicious is priceless.</prosody>
ssml: <prosody pitch = '+2st'>I love helping others. It’s important for me to follow the rules and to do what is right.</prosody>
ssml: <prosody pitch = '+2st'>I love sharing knowledge with as many people as possible. Apart from that, I like having conversations with different people about many sorts of topics.</prosody>
